d:
Munbaee men divali se pahle brihanmunbaee mahangarpalika yani biemsi ne ek jagrukta abhiyan shuru kiya hai. ismen logon se patakhe na jalane aur paryavran ke anukul divali manane ki apil ki ja rahi hai. is abhiyan men film aur kriket jagat ki kaee jani-mani hastiyon ko shamil kiya gaya. inmen abhinetri diya mirza, madhuri dikshit, marathi abhinetri nishigandha vad aur kriketar ajinky rahane shamil the. lekin 1 navanbar ko biemsi ke soshal midiya akaunt par diya mirza ka vidiyo samne aane ke bad vivad shuru ho gaya.
Riport: tim bibisi nyuz hindi
Aavaz: navin negi
